fail_safe_negative_without_protocol.explanation: Without freeze/begin-recovery rotating ledger_epoch, events 3..5 remain state='archived' on the node (acked_through=5). While idle, Uploader.due() is false and nothing is sent. Once post-T1 traffic creates event > 5 in outbox, the node uploads only the new event under the old ledger_epoch; central advances max_seen_seq while returning highest_contiguous_seq=2, which the node rejects with ErrAckRegress ('usagestore: ack watermark cannot move backwards in the same epoch').
